title: Detection of additive exact finite preservation in a conservative square
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian]. Let $p:\mathcal C\to\mathcal A$, $q:\mathcal D\to\mathcal B$, and $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive functors [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor] preserving short exact sequences [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Suppose $q$ is faithful and conservative, meaning that its maps on morphism sets are injective and that a morphism of $\mathcal D$ is an isomorphism whenever its image under $q$ is an isomorphism. Let $H:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor, not assumed additive, equipped with a natural isomorphism $\eta:q\circ H\xrightarrow{\sim}L\circ p$. Then $H$ is additive and preserves short exact sequences. Moreover $H$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits, def-galois-exact-functor], including the zero object, finite biproducts, kernels, cokernels, equalizers and coequalizers. All these preservation assertions concern the images of the given universal cones and cocones under $H$, not merely the existence of isomorphic objects.

source.place: lines 138-150, equivariant additive and finite-preservation instances; general conservative-square argument extracted from returned proof steps 2-3. Supporting source: lean/WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/Endofunctor/IsoAlgebra.lean, lines 63-93; Mathlib Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/ExactFunctor.lean, exact_tfae.

proof.text: The composite p ⋙ L is additive. Transport additivity across eta.symm using Mathlib Functor.additive_of_iso to obtain additivity of H ⋙ q. Then Functor.additive_of_comp_faithful H q proves that H is additive, so it preserves zero morphisms.

For a short exact complex S, hp and hL give short exactness of (S.map p).map L. The natural isomorphism eta.symm induces S.mapNatIso eta.symm from S.map (p ⋙ L) to S.map (H ⋙ q). Mathlib ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso transports short exactness to the latter. ShortComplex.map_comp identifies these complexes with their iterated maps.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.ShortExact.reflects_shortExact_of_faithful q to S.map H and the short exact complex obtained in the preceding step. Its hypotheses are only faithfulness and preservation of zero morphisms, which follow from the hypotheses and additivity of q. This proves that H preserves short exact sequences without using hq or conservativity of q. The Mathlib reflection theorem reflects the endpoints by cancellation and reflects middle exactness via the kernel-inclusion/cokernel-projection zero-composite criterion.

Apply the equivalence (H.exact_tfae.out 0 3).mp to preservation of short exact sequences. This is the equivalence cited in lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology, and gives PreservesFiniteLimits H and PreservesFiniteColimits H. These classes preserve the universal properties of the actual mapped cones and cocones, including empty and parallel-pair diagrams. Additivity supplies preservation of finite biproducts, including the empty family, through the mapped biproduct identities. Package the additive instance and the three preservation assertions.
